# telnyx_private_wireless_gateways (Data Source)

Lists private wireless gateways, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_private_wireless_gateway`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_created_at` (String)
- `filter_ip_range` (String)
- `filter_name` (String)
- `filter_region_code` (String)
- `filter_updated_at` (String)
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `private_wireless_gateways` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--private_wireless_gateways))

<a id="nestedatt--private_wireless_gateways"></a>
### Nested Schema for `private_wireless_gateways`

Read-Only:

- `address_mode` (String) The address mode of the private wireless gateway. With static, each SIM card gets a fixed IP address from the gateway's IP range that is preserved across sessions. With dynamic, IP addresses are assigned by the network at attach time and may change between sessions.
- `assigned_resources` (Attributes List) A list of the resources that have been assigned to the Private Wireless Gateway. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--private_wireless_gateways--assigned_resources))
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was created.
- `id` (String) Identifies the resource.
- `ip_range` (String) IP block used to assign IPs to the SIM cards in the Private Wireless Gateway.
- `name` (String) The private wireless gateway name.
- `network_id` (String) The identification of the related network resource.
- `record_type` (String)
- `region_code` (String) The name of the region where the Private Wireless Gateway is deployed.
- `status` (Attributes) The current status or failure details of the Private Wireless Gateway. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--private_wireless_gateways--status))
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was updated.

<a id="nestedatt--private_wireless_gateways--assigned_resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `private_wireless_gateways.assigned_resources`

Read-Only:

- `count` (Number) The current count of a resource type assigned to the Private Wireless Gateway.
- `record_type` (String) The type of the resource assigned to the Private Wireless Gateway.


<a id="nestedatt--private_wireless_gateways--status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `private_wireless_gateways.status`

Read-Only:

- `error_code` (String) This attribute is an [error code](https://developers.telnyx.com/docs/development/api-fundamentals/api-errors) related to the failure reason.
- `error_description` (String) This attribute provides a human-readable explanation of why a failure happened.
- `value` (String) The current status or failure details of the Private Wireless Gateway. <ul> <li><code>provisioning</code> - the Private Wireless Gateway is being provisioned.</li> <li><code>provisioned</code> - the Private Wireless Gateway was provisioned and able to receive connections.</li> <li><code>failed</code> - the provisioning had failed for a reason and it requires an intervention.</li> <li><code>decommissioning</code> - the Private Wireless Gateway is being removed from the network.</li> </ul> Transitioning between the provisioning and provisioned states may take some time.
